content_sections.heading: IIT Madras Junior Executive Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the IIT Madras Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download IIT Madras Junior Executive Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Junior Executive: Bachelor of Commerce (B. Com), Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA), or equivalent with 0 to 1 Years of experience

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: All Posts: Maximum age limit is 30 years. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Madras Junior Executive Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 25-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Madras to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for Junior Executive at IIT Madras?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for the Junior Executive post in IIT Madras recruitment 2026. This is a contract-based position at a prestigious institution.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Madras Junior Executive recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Junior Executive post is 25 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance to avoid last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Executive position at IIT Madras?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Junior Executive post should not be more than 30 years of age. Age relaxation may be applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the Junior Executive post?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a Bachelor of Commerce (B. Com), Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA), or an equivalent degree with 0 to 1 year of experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Junior Executive post at IIT Madras?
faq.answer: The salary for the Junior Executive position ranges from Rs. 16,000 to Rs. 20,000 per month. This is a competitive salary for a contract role.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the IIT Madras Junior Executive recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment. This makes it accessible for all eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the IIT Madras Junior Executive vacancies?
faq.answer: Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the official IIT Madras website. Ensure all details are filled correctly and documents are uploaded as required.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Junior Executive post?
faq.answer: The selection process includes shortlisting based on applications, followed by a test/interview, and finally document verification. Candidates should prepare accordingly.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website for IIT Madras recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for IIT Madras recruitment and to apply for this post is https://icandsr.iitm.ac.in. All official notifications and updates will be available there.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contract position?
faq.answer: The Junior Executive position at Indian Institute of Technology Madras is a contract-based job. The duration of the contract will be specified in the official notification.
